Complete the remaining release-gate corrections for #538 after the NuGet authentication fix merged in #539. Main run [40883578849](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/actions/runs/40883578849) authenticated through OIDC and passed all build/documentation validation, then rejected its publishing token by treating the repository API's user-role `permissions.push` field as proof of installation-token write access. The same token subsequently pushed gh-pages successfully.

The GitHub preflight now validates repository identity/access and preserves bounded, credential-redacted HTTP diagnostics. It explicitly leaves write capability unverified until the existing metadata, mirror and release writes succeed. Those operations remain fatal, with the existing `contents: write` and `packages: write` requirements. NuGet authentication order, temporary-key refresh, provided-token fallback, package versions and aggregate required-job rules are preserved.

The documentation deployment also exposed five credential-scanner false positives in public DocFX source-map identifiers. One exact historical commit/file/rule/line fingerprint excludes only those confirmed identifiers; complete history scanning and all rules remain enabled. See [reproduction evidence](experiments/issue-538/source-map-findings.md).

Fixes #538

Validation and reproduction:

- Added the two GitHub preflight regressions before applying the correction: five assertion failures reproduced missing/empty/false/true role-field handling and lost HTTP diagnostics.
- All **85 Python regression tests pass**, covering the original OIDC HTTP 400 case, every preflight caller, credential selection/retry, scope limitations, public download polling, release repair and the new GitHub cases.
- Repository configuration, automatic-version policy, actionlint 1.7.12/ShellCheck, zizmor 1.29.0 and native formatting pass locally.
- Gitleaks 8.30.1 reproduced five findings at the exact historical documentation commit before the exception; the focused scan passes afterward. Full-history scan passes across **3,307 commits / 377.72 MB**. Local C# checks pass restore/build/format, all **193 tests**, both examples, package creation and its isolated consumer.
- Current full PR CI: [40915593257](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/actions/runs/40915593257), head `461178dbaf44f64c4037b6dc949c9b15eca34d63`. **Complete PR CI passes**, including `required`, both C# OS legs, GCC/Clang/sanitizers, documentation, links, full-history audit and all CodeQL analyses. Codacy passes after correcting its two Markdown line-length findings. Native dependency setup and C11/C++20 FFI checks pass locally; the single local test build reached its intentional 1.25 GiB process cap (peak RSS 1,219,348 KiB), without a host OOM, and is not repeated. The hosted matrix supplies complete native validation. The isolated local C++ packaged consumer also passes (peak RSS 479,572 KiB). Local DocFX/Doxygen/API/PDF documentation and link checks pass: **546 HTML pages**, a **282-page Unicode source PDF**, zero warnings/errors.

Main verification: merged as `7c6ade625fd4ebf890393dc9bf31d055d45d364f` and followed
[the matching push-triggered run 40917637619](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/actions/runs/40917637619).
All validation jobs pass: both C# platforms, GCC/Clang/sanitizers, all security
analyses, docs, quality and links. The corrected GitHub preflight passes.
Documentation deployed successfully; all 1,050 files match the tested artifact,
and anonymous API/PDF downloads match byte for byte.

**Issue #538 remains unfinished/open.** The actual metadata push fails with
`GH006` before package publication. A narrow Actions-app push allowance was
accepted, but [failed-job-only attempt 2](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/actions/runs/40917637619/attempts/2)
still rejected the built-in token. A user allowance returned empty; an alternative
disabled ruleset was rejected with HTTP 422 because the Actions integration is
not eligible. Every original protection setting was restored; no ruleset,
credential, force push or manual version bump was introduced.

Both expected NuGet versions (`0.18.4`, `0.1.1`) and public GitHub releases return
404. Metadata, registry pushes/mirrors, public package consumers, release assets
and green `publish`/`required` remain unverified. Completing the protected write
requires a supported automation identity/metadata flow; changing the already
merged workflow requires further PR work beyond the single-PR constraint.
Detailed run conclusions, sanitized errors, settings attempts and remaining
acceptance are recorded in the [issue description](https://github.com/linksplatform/Data.Doublets/issues/538).
The provided fallback secret and verified NuGet policy are unchanged.
